attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to require new user passwords be at least 12 characters with at least 3 character classes, via libpam-pwquality (minlen=12, minclass=3) wired into /etc/pam.d/common-password ahead of pam_unix. Verified enforcement live (reject short password, reject low-diversity password, accept compliant password) both before and after a full node reboot, and confirmed the boot identity actually changed across the restart. Test users were created and cleaned up afterward.
